outside_exact.input: before labels, routed after labels, changed mask, edit region, footprint, taxonomy

definition.outside_pixel_exact: Fraction of valid outside pixels whose uint8 label is exactly unchanged; tolerance is zero pixels.
definition.outside_room_level_exact: Binary conjunction over all untouched before-edit room instances after one-to-one room matching, label equality, polygon tolerance, and adjacency preservation.
definition.outside_room_label_exact: All matched untouched room instances preserve their semantic room label.
definition.outside_room_polygon_exact: All matched untouched room polygons have boundary Hausdorff distance <= 0.5 px.
definition.outside_edge_exact: The induced adjacency edge set among untouched room instances is identical after one-to-one mapping.
definition.locality_violation_rate: Changed valid outside pixels divided by all valid outside pixels.

outside_exact.matching: One-to-one Hungarian matching; same semantic room type required; IoU >= 0.5; no many-to-one match.
negative_controls: Move one untouched room mask by 1 px.
Change one untouched room semantic label.
Change one adjacency relation without moving pixels.

validity.input: predicted wall plan, room instances, taxonomy

definition.validity: Conjunction of all five validity checks.
definition.outer_boundary_closed: Footprint contains a non-degenerate closed exterior ring.
definition.room_polygon_closed: Every room resolves to a non-degenerate closed ring.
definition.no_room_overlap: No pairwise room interior overlap exceeds 4 px2 (a 2x2 grid-snap sliver).
definition.semantic_complete: Every room has a legal taxonomy room label.

negative_controls: Make one room ring degenerate or non-closed.
Replace one room label with an illegal label.

conditional_watertightness.input: predicted room polygons and wall graph plus target-watertight eligibility
conditional_watertightness.definition: On eligible cases, rooms form a valid non-overlapping tiling of one connected interior without holes larger than 0.25 px2 and the wall graph is free of unclosed cycles.

node_f1.matching: Unique semantic room types; set membership; no positional tolerance and no many-to-one.

edge_overlap.input: predicted and target room-type adjacency graph
edge_overlap.matching: Undirected canonical semantic type pairs; adjacency means polygon boundaries within 2 px; no many-to-one.
negative_controls: Shift a shared edge beyond 2 px.

delta_iou.definition: Change-map IoU inside the declared valid edit region.
delta_iou.aggregation: Per-case values, operation distributions, room-count strata, edit-area strata, and hardest decile.

delta_mse.definition: Binary change-map mean squared error inside the declared valid edit region.
delta_mse.aggregation: Per-case values, operation distributions, room-count strata, edit-area strata, and hardest decile.

ged.definition: Unit-cost attributed GED over room-type nodes with unit edge insertion/deletion and zero-cost matching edges.

fixed_configuration.fallback: recorded and excluded from exact comparisons

ged.aggregation: Paired case differences, bootstrap CI, Wilcoxon signed-rank test; absolute values are not cross-paper comparisons.

aggregation.outside_exact: Mean of case-level binary exactness plus continuous violation rate separately.
aggregation.node_and_edge: Report precision, recall, F1, mean, SD, five-seed CI, and extrema.
